retry_policy.rule: retry/recovery may restart the scan from current accepted state; proposal fingerprints, not checkpoint position, prevent duplicate proposal authority

crash_recovery_policy.restart: discard in-memory candidate material and begin a fresh complete stable read Snapshot
crash_recovery_policy.committed_proposals: ordinary exact pending/rejected suppression remains authoritative and prevents duplicate equivalent rows
crash_recovery_policy.rule: checkpoint is bounded progress diagnostics only; stable-snapshot proposal fingerprints plus ordinary pending/rejected suppression prevent duplicate equivalent proposal history

cancellation_policy.authoritative_request: LLD-01 coordinator may cancel/revoke the technical job claim through its normal owner boundary
cancellation_policy.committed_domain_effect: already committed regroup proposals are non-authoritative history and are not deleted by job cancellation
cancellation_policy.rule: no Task plan/membership/Objective accepted topology is mutated by the job itself

jobs.sensitive_field_policy: payload/checkpoint contain only origin, command/job identities, bounded counters/phase and no Task arrays, Customer/RFC bodies, source rows or notes
jobs.coalescing: derive key OBJECTIVE_GROUPING_RECOMPUTE_V1:<origin>; coalesce only active queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait jobs for the same origin, never completed jobs

ObjectiveGroupingRecomputeCheckpointV1.rule: no resume cursor or component membership is authoritative; interruption restarts scan

execution_contract.replay: public command receipt replay resolves before Task/Objective owner reads and reuses the same durable job identity
execution_contract.snapshot: each attempt calculates all candidate proposals from one stable accepted-state Snapshot so no proposal set mixes input versions
execution_contract.bounded_memory: materialize only the same compact Task/Objective authority used by OBJECTIVE_STRICT_OVERLAP_GROUPING_V1; no source/workbook bodies and no O(n^2) overlap edge set. There is no product maximum on Task or component count.
execution_contract.publication: publish each unsuppressed stable-snapshot proposal in its own short writer transaction using the original accepted recompute command receipt as provenance. Post-snapshot drift may make the proposal immediately stale; GroupingProposalDetail and AcceptRegroupProposal detect that drift before any authoritative topology mutation.
execution_contract.totals: GroupingProposalList supplies exact_total independently of page length after publication
